rule: place name shared/near-identical across different GeoNames IDs
example: Sahiwal (31.97°N, 72.33°E), Sahiwal (30.67°N, 73.1°E), Bahawalnagar (30.0°N, 73.25°E), Arifwala, Alipur (Islamabad Capital Territory), Alipur (Punjab)

rule: identical daily PM2.5 series shared by several places (same model grid cell)
action: flagged (kept); inferential tests use one representative per series
example: Zaida, Tordher, Swabi, Sukkur, Sinjhoro, Sarai Alamgir
Chuhar Jamali, Pir Jo Goth, Khairpur Mir's, Zahir Pir, Washuk

rule: fixed annual mean + abrupt level shift
example: Sukkur, Rohri, Rahim Yar Khan, Multan, Mirpur Khas

rule: source-derived calendar/AQI columns dropped; calendar fields are recomputed from timestamp and AQI categories are not used
